notes.title: Update: Balance and Fixes
notes.notes: [p]This update is focused on polish, improving player feedback, economic balance, and other quality of life improvements. [/p][h3]Gameplay & Systems[/h3][list][*][p][b]Enemy Spawning[/b] issues fixed (or greatly reduced) cases where enemies didn’t spawn or only partially spawned. You should see more consistent waves now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laser Tower[/b] Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Towers now correctly fill their inventory with fuel cells.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fuel cell warning icon when they’re running low.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Missile Tower's[/b] functionality improvemented for more reliable air defense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Repair Hubs[/b] now properly works with the new transport system.[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings should now keep producing even when off-screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for [b]mines[/b] failing to recognize nearby ore tiles.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Economy & Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted [b]iron, aluminum, and copper prices/recipes[/b] for better balance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade prices[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Now scale by both upgrade type and tier, adding more strategic depth to your decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade prices increased to better match increased productivity of new transport system[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]UI & Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]Tooltips[/b] now appear in the correct position more consistently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solar Panel Warning Icon[/b] no longer shows up at night.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Feedback Form[/b] now includes screenshots to help make your reports more actionable and useful.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced instances where [b]blast effects[/b] didn’t fade out properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Save Validation[/b] should result in missing save files now correctly appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where [b]available worker counts[/b] were wrong after loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug preventing [b]enemy spawn points[/b] from activating properly after load.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Removed Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Orbital Lift project[/b] has been disabled pending more polish and improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Delivery Bug Fix
notes.notes:
A recent update that included a fix for the issue where laser towers did not always fill their inventory with fuel cells was causing deliveries to sometimes stop. 

The fix has been reverted until a better solution can be found. 

My apologies introducing a big bug by trying to fix a small bug!

notes.title: Transport Overhaul Update
notes.notes:
[p]The transportation update is here! Global storage is out and supply chains are in! 
[/p][p]This update fundamentally changes how you’ll design and optimize your colony. You'll need to plan carefully, connect strategically, and keep those workers fed and housed if you want productivity reports that won’t get you reassigned.  [/p][p][/p][h3]New Transport System[/h3][list][*][p]No more global storage! Every resource now moves through your transport hub network.  [/p][/*][*][p]Storage buildings have been replaced with Transport Hubs — the backbone of your supply chain.[/p][/*][*][p]Connections are now more important and are no longer made automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Build connections between buildings and tiles to move goods where they’re needed.  [/p][/*][*][p]"Allowed Resources" per transport hub allow control of the flow of resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/e5c4dde33ceb4171ce43191b51434bebe8d5e5c3.png"][/img][/p][h3]World Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Resources are spawned in fewer but larger clumps to reflect the organizational changes required by the new transportation system.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Workers[/h3][list][*][p]Workers now ride along with resources as they’re delivered - no need to deliver them.[/p][/*][*][p]Housing now requires food and water deliveries to keep your workers compliant.  [/p][/*][*][p]The HQ no longer provides housing.[/p][/*][*][p]Workers can now be hired without adequate housing, but worker compliance and efficiency will suffer. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Supply Ships[/h3][list][*][p]Exporting resources no longer requires you to use the market window.[/p][/*][*][p]Supply ships now have “allowed resources” settings. They’ll automatically export any resource that is delivered to the supply ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Importing resources is still handled in the market window. You will need to select which supply ship handles the incoming resources.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/99cead7e2068eadf2ed8c71faee0760eb63ba8f3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Rebalanced upgrade costs and daily worker expenses.  [/p][/*][*][p]Some upgrades have been shifted to new tiers to better fit progression. [/p][/*][*][p]There are still lots of tweaks and adjustments coming in future updates. [/p][/*][/list][h3]QOL[/h3][list][*][p]Resource connection networks shown when hovering over resource in the HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]Connection priority now shown in the unit window. [/p][/*][*][p]Supply ships can now import resources with out returning to the landing site.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3][list][*][p]Enemies should now spawn every night.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies not spawning should no longer block the progression of the day night cycle. [/p][/*][*][p]Sharing violations with the auto save should be reduced or no longer an issue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]This update should not break old saved games.[/b] However, the changes to the transportation system will likely require large reorganization of your colonies. Starting a new colony is recommended.[/p][p][/p][h3]Future Work & Known Issues[/h3][list][*][p]Refinement of how workers consume food and water.[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing of costs with increased income.[/p][/*][*][p]Daily costs of scout units needs to be incorporated in to colony costs.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Updates: New WIP Game Systems
notes.notes:
[p]It’s always a bit scary to talk about possible or potential features, but that’s what this update is going to do.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the worst of the bugs and performance issues fixed and, if we’re honest, sales slowing after the initial release it seemed like a good time to turn my focus to potential future features for DSD. Not because the game is perfect and flawless, but because some of these ideas will help shape the solutions to other design questions.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the earliest systems prototyped for DSD was a world map or galactic map. Some basic ideas were mapped out and functional, but after that the prototype was shelved for possible use in the future. And that time? It’s getting close. [/p][p] [/p][p]The current vision is to have the player start in a small and simple world. The world will have just the few resources needed to get the player started and learn the core systems of the game. Then! With enough resources you’ll be able to purchase a license from “The Corporation” to found an additional colony. You’ll be able to choose from worlds with a mix of resources. Ideally choosing a world that will let you expand and build from additional tiers of the tech tree. [/p][p][/p][p]Instead of building a single colony you’ll be able to build a network of colonies shipping resources from one to the other - building your empire of factories and workers. You won’t abandon colonies. They will continue to function and ship resources. And if you ever want to go back and update a colony? You’ll be able to do that too.[/p][p][/p][p]As the image of the map prototype below suggests… It's still VERY early in the design process. The next idea is more likely to see the light of day before the world map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/a6d01017bdd669f9584e8c0b0949482052410fac.png"][/img][/p][p]DSD was designed to be a resource management game without micro-management. And I think that’s been achieved, but maybe a little too well? [/p][p][/p][p]For the last several months I’ve been exploring tweaks and changes to the resource transportation system. Asking lots of [i][b]what if[/b][/i] questions. All with the goal of bringing back a little more puzzle or a little more management to the game while trying to steer clear of massive menus or constant fiddling with settings to min/max the colony’s productivity. There’s nothing wrong with games like that - DSD just wasn’t designed to be that kind of game.[/p][p] [/p][p]While far from final, the latest prototype attempts to answer the question “What if the storage wasn’t global?” And the results are looking promising! [/p][p][/p][p]Got a mine that needs fuel cells? Simply connect a solar panel to it. Nothing new.[/p][p][/p][p]What’s new is the “transport hubs.” These effectively replace global storage. Got extra iron ore? Send it to a nearby transport hub! Then that hub will send to the next hub and then to the next and the next until there’s a connection with a smelter that needs the iron ore. [/p][p][/p][p]Instead of just having connections from one building to another - there will now be networks of connections for each resource.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/ebbbc8cd568ded1b6dbf7d18e6883ea3e88905ca.png"][/img][/p][p]To control the flow of resources through your network of transport hubs you’ll make connections and choose which resources a particular transport hub is allowed to handle. It’s still simple, but it brings back some of the planning and puzzle that was missing in DSD. [/p][p] [/p][p]This system is much further along than the world map and will hopefully be making an appearance in a public version of DSD in the coming weeks.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: More ships! More trading! More Credits!
notes.notes:
This patch is all about the early game economy. Getting those resources shipped out and the tech credits rolling in faster and easier. This means more supply ships, increasing the transaction limit and letting the auto trader put in more orders. 

The patch also comes with a healthy dose of QOL improvements and bug fixes.
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added build +1 supply ship upgrade to the first tier of tech tree.
[*]More supply ships allowed per upgrade.
[*]Max number of market transactions now scales with the number of supply ships.
[*]Max number of autotrader transactions now scales with the number of supply ships.
[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Production tooltips now reflect game time, not real time.
[*]Directives now sorted by type.
[*]Range indication no longer shows overlapping ranges. 
[*]UI scaling preference now correctly saving. 
[*]Destroying partially constructed buildings now returns delivered resources.
[*]New crystals take longer to power up.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Supply ship upgrades correctly display image in tech tree tooltip. 
[*]Fixed button tooltips in game the scene.
[*]Collection towers only collect during the day.
[*]Fixed issue where recipes would sometimes not show in unit window.
[*]Tiles can no longer be built outside of shuttle range.
[*]Fixed issues where worker achievement was not triggering.
[*]Fixed issue where location button didn't correctly load saved location.
[*]Terraflux should now correctly unlock at the factory.
[*]Fixed issue were game could crash after saving.
[/list]

There are still known bugs and more balancing that needs to happen - but this felt like a significant enough patch ;) Lots of good suggestions still need to get implemented!

notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
This update is all about performance plus some quality of life improvements. The game went through another round of optimization which should be very noticeable when the number of buildings is large. Load and save times should also be significantly shorter. 

With the shorter save time, proper auto-saving has been implemented. At the start of each day the game will now automatically save. Auto saving can be turned off and the save interval can be increased in the game settings menu.
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Proper auto-save functionality. 
[*]Resource amounts in resource tiles are now randomized within a range.
[*]You can now send save files from the load/save menus if you encounter an issue with game.
[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Much better performance for larger outposts with larger numbers of buildings. 
[*]Player set game speed now resets at the start of a new day.
[*]Load and save times should be significantly shorter. 
[*]Iron ore tiles near the start location have significantly more ore.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Loaded games should now start at the same time of day as when the game was saved.
[*]Scout unit indicator now correctly displays when units are on a tree tile.
[*]Auto save should now correctly rotate through the 5 save files.
[*]A sharing violation bug that would cause the game to freeze has been fixed.
[/list]

There’s lots more in the works. But next up is another round of polish and balance for the early game economy. That means looking at prices, recipes for production, order of upgrades in the tech tree and potentially expanding the players export capacity.

notes.title: Version 0.1009 Update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes! The latest build (version 0.1009) brings with it primarily bug fixes and one new feature to help with sharing bugs and providing feedback. 

In the save and load menu to the right of each save file is a new bug icon that will open the feedback form. When the form is submitted the log files and the save game file will be submitted. Hopefully this will lead to identifying bugs faster. 

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Bug Reporting: Share save files and log files from the save and load menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/77af8e967fa420cc311e7fa493fee267fbd307c5.png[/img]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Random crashing from the game scene - due to accidental loading of a save file. 
[*]Missing build cost for some players should now be resolved.
[/list]
On a personal note, I deeply appreciate the support and patience of all of the DSD players. The timing of the game's release coincided with a significant family emergency. My ability to update the game and respond to bug requests was not what I had hoped. While I expect some continued disruptions, development of DSD can hopefully now get back to a normal-ish schedule. Thank you again!

notes.title: Performance, Polish and New Upgrades
notes.notes:
This update (v 0.1) has been all about improving performance, adding polish, building out the 3rd tier of the tech tree (full version) and of course getting ready for releasing Deep Space Directive into early access! 

The all new auto-trader can be unlocked in the 3rd tier of the tech tree - think of it as an assistant to help keep the credits flowing. Plus new special projects bring more progression to the DSD story and timeline! 

This build also brings with it all new voice over rendering! It’s been the most requested feature so far. It’s still not perfect, but much of the robotic-ness of the voices is gone and replaced with smoother and more natural sounding voices.

The performance and quality of life improvements will be in demo and non-demo builds of DSD. Additional content is only accessible in the full-version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/12f5301a54176156892542d8bb836bf7999f1f51.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]3rd tier of the tech tree! New buildings and new resource production chains.
[*]Bio harvesters collect biomass from surrounding forests and bio reactors turn that biomass into fuel cells.
[*]Oil and gas can now be collected and converted into fuel cells. 
[*]Steam achievements are now implemented for non-demo builds.
[*]New resource “TerraFlux” has been added. Provide another use for excess terrene.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/6a20eac969e22b92c244a1753fc3007c56636467.png[/img]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]All new rendering of voice over audio using an updated engine.
[*]Rebuilt enemy terrene drop system. This should help address performance issues with large numbers of drops. 
[*]Tech tree search bar! 
[*]New recipe selection window. Easier to find and easier to use. 
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]So many. I lost track.
[/list]

Thanks to all those who sent in feedback and bug reports! Keep sending them in!

notes.title: Performance improvements, New Resources and More Automation
notes.notes:
Development is going full steam ahead! With an anticipated early access release some time next year - hopeful early next year. A big focus has been performance improvements with a look towards larger colonies and more variety of buildings. This has included an update to the game engine plus countless improvements under the hood. 

While all of the performance improvements will make it into the demo, much of the new content is aimed at the next tier of the tech tree and won’t make an appearance in the demo. This includes, new special projects, new automation tools and new resource production chains - those tree tiles are about to get a little more useful!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]New “Urgent” priority added to buildings to allow players to quickly address the needs of a particular building. Only one building can be set as urgent priority at a time.
[*]Target frame rates have been added to the settings menu. Max your frame rate or keep the fans quiet!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/9a9f924ddcd7e0d3099918ae9448dcfb59bf9d10.png[/img]

[h2]Work in Progress[/h2]
[list]
[*]Development and balancing of the 3rd tier of the tech tree!
[*]Special projects! These are still in early development, but will give the player more medium term goals and help drive the story forward.
[*]The autotrader window helps automate the flow of resources and tech credits. It will allow youto set thresholds for each resource and will automatically place buy or sell orders. It won’t run your economy for you, but it’ll help prevent running out of tech credits or running too low on a particular resource. The autotrader can be unlocked in the 3rd tier of the tech tree.
[*]New biomass resource and production chain. Harvest those trees! The production chain will include a Harvester, Bio Reactor and a Bio Lab.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/75b68bd1b915c7d5f6939633d6540d4c771ed7c6.png[/img]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Better indication for when mobile units can’t move to a particular location.
[*]Double click functionality added to the save and load menu. It’s the small things :)
[*]The system for spawning Terrene from enemy units is getting a major performance overhaul.
[*]Cargo shuttle routing improvements should speed up delivery as well as improve overall performance of the system.
[*]Performance improvements with the UI.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where sometimes only one infantry unit would spawn with the HQ.
[*]Settings menus will now pause the game. 
[/list]

Thanks to all those who sent in feedback and bug reports! Keep sending them in!

notes.title: More Stats and QOL Improvements
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is over and the community had a ton of good suggestions and feedback! The latest build incorporates as much of those ideas as I’ve been able to add. Improvements include changes to land mass generation, more stats for production buildings, fixes to the save system and of course the much requested space bar properly pausing and unpausing the game. 

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]New production stats. “Up Time” is shown to give better feedback on how well a building is being supplied with needed resources and how well produced resources are being picked up.
[*]Hovering over recipe resources will now show how many units will be consumed or produced per minute to aid in optimization.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/9d7c6ad78ea2a37265b03d65e713ae670156a902.png[/img]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Land generation has been tweaked to generate more nearby land clusters as well as more iron ore deposits near the starting location.
[*]The space bar will now properly pause and unpause the game.
[*]Vysnc has been turned on to help keep those fans a bit quieter. Additional FPS target settings will be explored in the future.
[*]Location buttons will now select the unit, if a unit is stored, on the first click and will zoom on the second click.
[*]”First Play Setup” has been added to let users set audio volume before starting a game.
[*]Directives to “develop a resource” now have buttons to move to the marked location.
[*]Tooltips added to the communication and worker menus.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/cbff80ae310aecc15ed929ae1d8e100794c7c0a3.png[/img]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resolved the cause of several warnings. This may improve stability for some users.
[*]Resolved some errors preventing saved games from loading.
[/list]

Thanks to all those who sent in feedback and bug reports! Keep sending them in!

notes.title: Fix: Loading Saved Games
notes.notes:
Version 0.049 is now live. This brings a few fixes, most notably a fix for crashes caused by loading saved games. 

If you continue to have problems with loading saved games, please reach out. I would love to get a hold of the actual save files and see what is casuing the issues.

Other fixes include daily directives correctly being assigned after unlocking the tech tree. As well as a fix for the issue where a daily directive was assigned 4 times.

notes.title: Demo Update: Save and Load System
notes.notes:
You can now save your progress in the Deep Space Directive demo! This was initially not planned to be part of the demo, but it was clear that some people are playing the for multiple hours and for multiple play sessions - seemed like a save system would be handy.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Save and load system added. To make it extra easy to use, the game will do a quick autosave whenever you quit. Manual saves can be done from the pause menu.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/b9118c05c8d36cb01945a890fadd7df07595ceda.png[/img]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Save and Load system added! Definitely a quality of life improvement!
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where “develop ore” location directives could not be completed. 
[*]Fixed an issue where “kill 0” enemy directives were assigned and could not be completed.
[*]Fixed the issue when infantry units were removed and on a tree tile the unit indicator would not get removed.
[/list]

notes.title: Cargo Route Improvements - Version 0.046
notes.notes:
This update is all about cargo routes! Better visualizations, more information in menus plus a revamped tutorial. There are also a few bug fixes and some of your suggestions have been implemented. So keep the feedback coming! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/e978e0e566bd1072de38d6f0b170ebe18a7e385a.gif[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cargo routes now have a better animation to indicate the direction the cargo is being shipped.
[*]”Shuttle utilization” is now shown in the unit window. This value gives a measure of how busy the shuttles are at the selected building - helping you optimize cargo routes..
[*]The unit window now shows the resources being moved for each cargo route.
[*]A “remove connection” button has been added to the unit window. The “add connection” button was moved to the bottom of the unit window. Cargo connections can still be added/removed using SHIFT and LMB/RMB.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/b4596da07ed1d9d14175ff1b6c984f26b04d8dba.png[/img]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Priority delivery for building tiles has been increased to medium from low. 
[*]The game now pauses when the tech tree is open.
[*]Better button highlighting.
[*]Aspen (yellow) trees are now unlocked at the start.
[*]The tutorial got reworked for pacing and clarity. Hope it helps :)
[/list]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Enemies that can’t find a target should be better handled.
[*]Fixed a bug where an empty daily directive could appear when skipping the tutorial and no supply ship has been built.
[*]Fixed issue with minimap enemy indicator when UI had been scaled.
[*]Fixed tooltips for health and shields in the unit window.
[/list]

If you've submitted feedback - Thank You! There's been a ton of good ideas and they're slowly getting worked into the build :) I still have a long list of tweaks and suggestions.

notes.title: Patch 0.0452
notes.notes:
For some players the demo was crashing due to the day night cycle not initializing correctly. This patch should address this issue. 

The patch also includes better error detection and reporting - so these issues don't go undetected for so long ;)

notes.title: New Build - Version 0.044
notes.notes:
This update rolls out a ton of new QOL improvements based on feedback and watching people play. Fewer clicks, tutorial skipping, and more. 

Keep that feedback coming! If there’s something you think could be better, let’s hear it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/40cb79e182e503c988d8d89d48e085fb0e038ea9.gif[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Skip the Tutorial! If you've finished the tutorial once, you should now have the option to skip it on your next play through
[*]When powering down a building the workers will get returned to the nearest HQ or storage building. No need to destroy a building to redistribute workers.
[*]Edge scrolling can now be toggled on in the options menu - you asked for less clicking :)
[/list]
[h2]QOL[/h2]
[list]
[*]Less Clicking!
[*]Mobile units are now ready to move when they’re selected.
[*]When placing buildings you no longer have to hold shift to place an additional copy. Same is true when placing tiles.
[*]Space lasers are now automatically on when the window opens.
[*]When placing tiles, the blue placeholders now have a tool tip - letting you know you can cancel the placement with a right click!
[*]When the game is paused the camera movement should be fully functional.
[*]Supply ships are now automatically connected to HQ or storage buildings to make it easier to receive “buy” orders.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/c6cb6fc0b1ca09eb97817bf08bd8b69da8029d5a.png[/img]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]A few more “reload” bugs squashed.
[*]A bug triggered by losing a mobile infantry unit that broke parts of the day/night cycle and could cause enemies to freeze has been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Version 0.043
notes.notes:
Thanks to all those who have made videos, streamed the game and sent in feedback! Keep it coming!

This patch and the smaller patches over the last few days have fixed several bugs, added some quality of life improvements, and added a couple [i]smaller[/i] new features. The tutorial has also been updated to attempt to better introduce cargo connections.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Construction sites now have labels above the progress bar.
[*]Cargo connections now have icons to show what resources are being transported.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/46729e7fe28ad0c6efcfcd6638f9718d1fe8b802.png[/img]
[h2]QOL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Unneeded cargo connections are no longer being created.
[*]When placing tiles the tile will turn red when the tile can not be placed at the current location.
[*]Increased farm storage - should prevent farms from running out of resources so quickly.
[*]Opening menus will toggle off space lasers, placing buildings and placing tiles.
[*]Pressing escape will toggle off space lasers, placing buildings and placing tiles.
[*]Newly placed tiles will show as revealed rather than hidden if no player unit is nearby.
[*]The space laser should no longer shoot through UI objects.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/e193171ba37f8c472ad5d2bab3b0e324819f687a.png[/img]
[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Missing audio on first play through
[*]Game freezing after first night of combat (introduced after release, yikes)
[*]Hotkeys no longer triggering when typing feedback
[*]Fixed bugs by restarting the game without quitting the application.
[*]Fixed mobile units not always landing on the ground.
[*]Fixed cargo connection color - notably for laser tower connections
[*]Plus other smaller bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630960/Deep_Space_Directive_Demo/?beta=1]The demo is finally here![/url] The demo has access to the first two tiers of the tech tree and builds out the foundation of your colony’s economy and infrastructure. Power generation, basic mining, smelting and just a dash of factory production. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/2cab79b208c9591765425f8c344ba1a27de7877b.jpg[/img]
It’s no surprise that the goal of the demo is to give players a taste of the full game, but just as important is the goal to get feedback on the game itself. The demo has been up for a little over 24 hours and plenty of tweaks and refinements have been made - with a few slightly larger adjustments coming in the next few days. I’d love to hear your thoughts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/ff90189ed4243f749422a13112d3ebda3ecb7d64.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Release on August 23rd
notes.notes:
It’s been delayed, it’s been postponed, but it’s finally here! The Deep Space Directive demo has an official release date - August 23rd! Ready or not here it comes! The demo also has it's own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2630960/Deep_Space_Directive_Demo]Steam Page.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/2cab79b208c9591765425f8c344ba1a27de7877b.jpg[/img]
The DSD demo will feature the first 2, of at least 6, tiers of the tech tree and provide 1-2 hours of playtime. 10+ different and unique buildings will be available in the demo and will form the foundation of an industrial colony. The demo will feature two enemies, a short ranged ground enemy and an elite version of that same creature - more base enemy types have been prototyped and will be featured in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/a958943de6082b8dc0192053de8da02e30cb5410.jpg[/img]
As a solo developer, getting feedback is challenging. While I fully believe that the demo will provide a good experience for players and give a taste of the full game, I am still hoping for significant feedback. In this sense, I see the demo as an open beta. So leave a review, leave a comment in the discussions or stop by the DSD discord. I’d love to hear your thoughts!

[url=https://discord.gg/VUvA8rJVEY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/9d3a2cd391694bc9b5e42a237aa9d0330f10ff01.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Combat Update
notes.notes:
Combat has always been Deep Space Directives’s ugly stepchild that has largely been ignored beyond the initial prototyping. So no surprise it has been in desperate need of some love and polish. The latest version (0.039) brings two major additions to the combat system. 

You’ll now have access to upgradeable space lasers, and who doesn’t love space lasers? Use them to soften up the enemy swarm before it gets to your defenses or take out a swarm targeting an unprepared branch of your colony. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/acf0b773b032e71dcce82da89b4c089bdf19576e.gif[/img]

Frontline units such as the infantry, laser towers and collection towers now have upgradable shields to help dull that initial attack and make your colony more sustainable as swarms grow larger. Shields recharge at the start of each day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/26dcef9f491dccba06871cb632e2a8efd63f031d.gif[/img]

Combat is not the main focus of Deep Space Directive, but these 2 new mechanics plus other smaller improvements aim to add some juice, polish and most importantly player control when fighting off attackers

In other news, all progress on Deep Space Directive is directed towards a Steam release of a demo! With a likely release date sometime in August. The demo will be an open beta to gather feedback and improvements before Steam Next Fest in October. 

If you want to see more details as features are developed or get more involved in the development itself, then come join the all new DSD discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/VUvA8rJVEY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/9d3a2cd391694bc9b5e42a237aa9d0330f10ff01.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - A Demo Is Coming!
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is June 10th and Deep Space Directive plans to be there with a public demo (and a live stream or two). So much has changed over the last few months and I’m beyond excited to get it into players hands and get more feedback! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/2cab79b208c9591765425f8c344ba1a27de7877b.jpg[/img]

The demo should provide an hour plus of gameplay! The only limitation on gameplay is the tech tree - the first few tiers of the tech tree will be unlocked while later tiers are locked and still very much under development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636450/a958943de6082b8dc0192053de8da02e30cb5410.jpg[/img]
